message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine charges based on facts. The case includes:

- First part: theft (盗窃) of cash by swapping real money with counterfeit money while purchasing cigarettes. That's theft (盗窃) because he secretly took the victim's cash. Also involves use of counterfeit money (伪造货币使用) maybe but not listed. The label set includes "盗窃". Also there is "诈骗" (fraud) for the later part where he uses counterfeit money to pay partially and deceives the seller. Actually the second part (the third incident) is described as 诈骗罪: he pays with counterfeit money and some real money, deceiving the shopkeeper. That's fraud (诈骗). So charges: 盗窃;诈骗.

Check co-occurrence summary: 盗窃 co-occurs with other crimes but not needed. Fraud co-occurs with 引诱、容留、介绍卖淫 etc but not relevant.

Thus final answer: [罪名]盗窃;诈骗<eoa>
